style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley 2 X Pre-lit Snowy Christmas Trees with Hessian
style.toneOfVoice: Not every corner of the house has room for a full-sized tree, and that’s where this pair of trees comes in. Each 2ft tree sits in its own hessian base, so there’s no stand or pot to worry about, and the frosted, white-tipped branches give you a proper snow-dusted look at a small scale. Both trees carry 30 warm white LEDs woven through the branches. They’re battery powered, so you can put them wherever you like, and the built-in timer switches them on and off each day. Buying a pair means you can frame a doorway or dress two rooms in one go. For indoor use only. Batteries aren’t included – you will need three AA batteries for each tree. Handle the frosted finish with care and keep away from open flame and heat sources.
